retainedSurfaceComparison.method: Read original GLB index triangles and apply cleanup receipt sourcePolygonsKeptInCopiedOrder. Compare winding-sensitive cyclic-corner-canonical POSITION triangle multisets in common local glTF coordinates for all 57 unchanged fit objects, without rounding or welding. Match authored NORMAL vectors at the same canonical triangle corners. Coordinates exact; normals reported numerically, not asserted byte-identical.
retainedSurfaceComparison.scope: Original pilot plus 56 body mesh occurrences; 43,084 retained triangles. Two edited grips and two added mounts (944 triangles) excluded from original-surface equality; all 61 still included in bounds/transforms/count/validator checks.
retainedSurfaceComparison.normalLimitations: Original GLB normal floats can differ after Blender imported/split-normal encoding and glTF export. The actual cleanup receipt already records re-encoding differences for selected corner normals. This comparison quantifies direction drift; it cannot reconstruct every intermediate Bpy property or claim cryptographic equality to unrecorded live corner arrays.
